ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels, with black/dark-grey tones occupying >95% of the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A primary contiguous black field with a high-contrast diagonal white linear mark on the left lobe and several discrete, small circular white spots localized on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 65 degrees and a sharp vertex profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire span, with increased jaggedness and sharp pixel peaks concentrated near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping upwards and outwards from the median notch to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, textured pixel groups corresponding to barnacle colonization on both lateral tips; approximately four discrete circular white focal points on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent white linear mark oriented diagonally on the left lobe, roughly 1/3 distance from the left edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on the distal margins of both lobes; distinct linear scratch on the left lobe and multiple circular scars on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, dark-toned trailing appendage or organic material visible on the extreme lateral edge of the right lobe tip.
